notes.title: Pizza Slice - Steam Playtest incoming!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Ciao wannabe Pizza Managers![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]We’re setting up a limited access, closed playtest for [b]Pizza Slice [/b]- our upcoming cozy simulator in which you run a pizza restaurant business. The test is scheduled to last from [b]August 26th[/b] until [b]September 16th[/b]. To join, simply go to Pizza Slice’s [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice"]Steam Store Page[/url][/u] and click the green [b]“Request Access[/b]” button to be viable for participation.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s 100% free with the only requirement being able to run the game (that is being above the minimal system requirements). 
[/p][h3]Here’s the latest trailer for the game, enjoy![/h3][previewyoutube="5d_Os2XN0uk;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🍕About Pizza Slice[/h2][p][/p][p]If you’ve been dreaming of running an Italian restaurant with traditions right out of a cozy depiction of New York city, then you’re in for a treat! Pizza Slice is more than just a simulator, it is a true Italian adventure! Take on the role of Tonio, manage your family pizzeria, bake authentic Italian pizzas, fight the competition and grow your business. See if you can win the title of the best pizzeria in the area![/p][h3][b]Game features:[/b][/h3][p align="justify"][b]• The Dream - [/b]Experience a cozy Italy in the heart of a romanticized New York City: run an Italian pizzeria in the middle of a bustling American metropolis. • [b]The Business [/b]- owning a restaurant is not only about the food, but also managing ingredients, doing prep work, cleaning, and being the front face of the establishment. In Pizza Slice you need to master the whole business of running a restaurant, not only the food.[/p][p]• [b]The Buzz[/b] - you need to think on your feet - expand the amount of tables, buy better kitchenware, learn or create new recipes, fight your competition and fend off the culinary mafia all while doing your everyday chores. • [b]A cozy simulation [/b]- the above points make you sweaty? Relax and have-a-go! Pizza Slice at its heart is a romantic and humorous depiction of what it means to run a modern restaurant business. • [b]A portion for two [/b]- you will have your unique staff at the restaurant but why not invite a friend and play together? It’s half the buzz and double the fun! [/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🥓What can you expect from the build?[/h2][p][/p][p]A single player experience, which will showcase the basic gameplay loop: from shopping for ingredients, through prep work, to creating pizzas, serving them and keeping your clientele satisfied. The game will allow you to play for 5 in-game days - enough to get a grasp for the mechanics and the flow of the game, while leaving an appetite for more.[/p][p][/p][p]The amount of available ingredients and ways in which you can expand your restaurant and your business will be limited. However, you will still be able to compose your own pizzas and set your own prices for them.[/p][p][/p][p]Pizza Slice continues to be in development. The current state of the build does not represent the final quality of the game.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🌿Why are we doing the Playtest?[/h2][p]We strongly believe that modern games should be created alongside the game’s community. We’re looking forward to hearing your feedback about the overall enjoyment of the experience, how well the gameplay loop keeps you interested, and in which direction you would want to see the game expanding.[/p][p][/p][p]The playtests will help us find and resolve unforeseen issues and make the game experience tighter. If you have not been selected for this round of tests - don’t worry, you will remain in the pool of possible participants for any future playtests.[/p][p]Please also bear in mind that this playtest will be a closed one, so no sharing or streaming yet - the game is still in development and not yet in a fully representative state for the general public. Thank you for respecting the embargo.[/p][p][b]Build Information & Requirements[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Platform[/b]: Windows PC via Steam[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support[/b]: Partial Support[/p][/*][*][p][b]Supported Languages[/b] - VO: English, Text & Interface: ENG, FR, IT, GER, ESP, PL, PT-BR, RUS, PT, Simplified CN.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hardware Minimum Requirements[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Windows 7 (64-bit) or newer[/p][/*][*][p]Intel Core i3, 3,20Ghz / AMD Phenom II X4 955, 3,2Ghz[/p][/*][*][p]4 GB RAM[/p][/*][*][p]Nvidia GeForce GTX 560 / AMD R7-260x[/p][/*][*][p]DirectX 11[/p][/*][*][p]6 GB free HDD Space[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45047327/e00c11da06afea0c97c450539317f9ff2161465d.png"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]🤌How to Join?[/h3][olist][*][p]Go to the Pizza Slice Steam Page now. You can follow the link [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385290/Pizza_Slice"]HERE[/url][/u].[/p][/*][*][p]Click on the [b]Request Access [/b]button found on the playtest section of the page.[/p][/*][*][p]That’s it! You’re signed in. Now patiently await for a confirmation email.[/p][/*][*][p]The playtests will begin on August 26th, 2025.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3]👌Got questions?[/h3][p]The easiest way to ask us questions is by joining our Discord server and asking us directly. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdgxrgVF4rsFiLGxN6XXtLCul8Bc6Ar21tfewUVXyPhEJ7Qf6BMZ1GFIy80DV1hYG_lCxabprQ-e1bHlI4NI521-UceWfDo4kNNpgzg4V6_kZEOyjR0P9bHw58okn-N0ldqLyAIZg?key=4PCsGwNRpUgMuhXU8r85kA"][/img]
[/p][p][/p][p]See you at the table, really soon![/p][p][/p][p]The Gaming Factory Team[/p]

notes.title: Meet your enemies
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

Last time I introduced you to our pack. Today it is our turn to get to know our opponents better. As the saying goes: know thy enemy and know yourself; in a hundred battles, you will never be defeated! So let us begin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/1fc8c8b82f2f838f3de2871b67af6c53f62e3b14.jpg[/img]

The first opponents we encounter are slow and not very intelligent cavemen. However, we may come across individuals who look like the gym is their second home....
 
The next stage is to prepare for an air raid! The enemies have wings, so you need to brush up on building the right towers to defend against these flying nasties.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Amo9bA2.png[/img] 
[h2]They are coming![/h2]
The further we go, the more experienced our enemies become. The Roman soldier, the Greek warrior - they are armed to the teeth! But if we can destroy their shields and helmets, victory will be ours! 

Just as our enemies came at us with spears and swords, the Middle Ages will see the first archers capable of damaging our Gervase base from a distance! I hope I can aim better with my slingshot than they can with their bows....

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jeLYhhf.gif[/img]
[h2]Attack![/h2]
I recently sent Barbara out to scout, and she discovered that some of the enemies have guns and ride horses - they must be very fast. Our Mikey may have a problem escaping, but rest assured... we have our trusty towers!

The biggest problem we might have is with exploding units. Once you manage to hit them, you have to be careful because the explosion and the range of fire are quite far! Remember to keep your distance and if anything happens, run for your life!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jp0iDe3.gif[/img]
As you can see, we have to be ready for anything! In each era we will face different enemies with different skills. Let's stick together and work together, because the more of us, the better. You can also invite your friends to join you in this adventure by playing the co-op mode in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/] the Lesson Learned demo.[/url]

See you in the next lesson

notes.title: Meet our pack!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear students,[/h1]

You have already learned about all the eras we will visit on our sleepy journey. Now that you know what to expect and how to prepare well to survive, it's time to introduce you to [b]our team![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/f62c9dfa014b2be69e1f3cdd2e393f1e88f3b9c0.jpg[/img]

I think you already know me very well - who wouldn't know [b]Frank[/b]? After all, I am the leader of this insanely brave group.

It wasn't easy for us to choose a team leader, but we held a rubber balloon making competition and of course I won! Everyone knows that I am unbeatable at it. I also have other qualities - for example, I'm a great slingshot shooter - I'm a bit less good at shooting on tests....

[h2]Our female warriors[/h2]
You know [b]Amelia[/b], right? She's my best friend and our brains! She looks a bit like the history lady in those glasses, but don't worry - she's a geek, but not as boring as the teachers..

As for [b]Barbara[/b], she's the best scout I could find - and not just because no one else applied... She also brings us strawberry ice-cream and eats my sandwiches when I don’t want them !

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rCuWUXM.gif[/img]
[h2]Our male warriors[/h2]
Maybe you had a classmate who dreamed of a career in sport, despite getting an 'F' grade in Physical Education? That's our [b]Mickey[/b]. He won't run a marathon, but he's the strongest of our group and he's great at building towers!

Every team needs a strategist, and in our case it is [b]Steven[/b]. He always has great ideas and draws well, although he is not very talkative. Sometimes he's absent-minded and looks like he's plotting something... He looks a bit scary then.

And finally, the finances of our gang - [b]Christopher[/b]. As they say, a lot of money - not a lot of brains. He may not be very intelligent, but we complement each other very well...and he tells funny jokes.

notes.title: Get into the tank
notes.content:
[h1]Dear students,[/h1]

Today we are going to talk about the last, but closest to us - The Modern Era! You'd better get your notebooks out and take notes, because I have a lot of information for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/7bfb83c9561eed81e50d2dca2b18442d31c4b607.jpg[/img]

On our next dreamy journey, we will go back to the very dangerous times of the Second World War. Grey streets, explosions and dust floating in the air - doesn't sound encouraging, does it?

But before we go, let's put our helmets on our heads - after all, it's the most important part of our body! We eat with it, and what would life be without food, a disaster...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/0db729af498872b74e0d15a5a17be8cf8918bd7b.png[/img]

You may be wondering what dangers await us. First of all, we have to watch out for well-trained soldiers lurking around every corner. Phew it's a good thing we have Barbara on the team, she's an amazing scout.

Our history teacher also said that tanks took to the street in those days! I'm afraid a simple tower won't help us and we need to improve it a bit. I hope Steven will come up with something, his ideas are always good!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YwhSwRu.gif[/img]
[h2]He likes to smoke. Let’s smoke him![/h2]
During the Second World War, we can meet many powerful people, but definitely one stands out above the rest. A big (literally) politician and leader with a penchant for cigars - probably only eating was better than smoking for him.
	
Sir Winston was very poised and was considered a great speaker. I resemble him a little in this, however when it comes to appearance our Mikey is definitely more like him....

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uvVbJMn.gif[/img]
[h2]We need to be careful, they have guns[/h2]
This is the end of our lesson today, as I have homework to do. Prepare well for the next journey and don't forget to bring your slingshot! The soldiers may have guns, but we are smarter than them...As they say, practice makes perfect, so I suggest you practice shooting now in our
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/] demo Lesson Learned.[/url]

notes.title: Frogs and snails
notes.content:
[h1]Dear students,[/h1]

It promises to be a very elaborate lesson. No, we will not be building towers this time. I will introduce you to [b]the Napoleonic Era[/b] today, but before we get to that, a few words about the [b]Renaissance[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/cb7df96032c1cff5880d88ef747626f99fa826dd.jpg[/img]

The representative of the Renaissance is Leonardo Da Vinci, an outstanding genius, painter, architect - our Steven is also imaginative and loves to draw... maybe he will still be human?

Da Vinci invented many interesting structures, including war machines. We should learn from him how to build strong towers! I hear he also designed a helicopter - let's hope it won't be used against us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/46042b23ae0105e1da0cd3c1175d277aabb9b30d.png[/img]
[h2]They have the best Croissants[/h2]
On a recent school trip we went to Paris. We visited museums and learned about French history. But what we enjoyed most were the cafés where we ate delicious, legendary croissants - even Mikey indulged in his diet that day.

I was very impressed with the Eiffel Tower. Ehhh... I'd like to build towers like that when I grow up. Just think - such a tall watchtower would surely beat even those ridiculous Da Vinci helicopters!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YIqsxP7.gif[/img]
[h2]I’m not afraid of your baguettes [/h2]
The history lady said that the Napoleonic era was a time of many wars. The French state was headed by a brilliant - but very short in stature - strategist, Napoleon Bonaparte (He he...Barbara says the name is more suited to a cat than a great emperor).

A fearless commander, he brought peace to the state and introduced many changes, but his greatest successes were on the battlefield. His army was strong and invincible. Probably because he fed them with frogs and snails, as is common in France. I wonder if they used baguettes instead of swords?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qnDdPWu.gif[/img]
The school trip was very successful and peaceful, but when we return to Napoleon's time, things are not going to be so colourful. So take a look at the building plans created by the Renaissance genius, as we could certainly use some new towers to defend Gervase! Today's lesson was a little different from the previous ones, but I hope you are ready for the next adventure. notes.title: Knights and princesses
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

Today a lesson straight from a real fantasy movie, which I recently watched with friends. To properly prepare for the next expedition, we must move to the distant times of the [b]Middle Ages[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/92d3dc5bd7e95ffb8228c5906d3437479bbe3250.jpg[/img]

Everyone loves fairy tales about brave knights. It is from this era that writers and poets draw the most inspiration about princesses locked in towers, waiting for the arrival of their saviors.

I also always wanted to be a knight. I'm fearless like them, I know how to fight with weapons, my mighty slingshot, I even have my squire, Mikey! All I need is a princess to save.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/523132bad8e10035fe38e68dafdb65309de08b61.png[/img]
[h2]I bet you don’t even know how to read[/h2]
Society in the Middle Ages was divided into four layers. The highest-ranking nobility with many rights, learned clerics, industrious burghers, and enslaved peasants. Eh, peasant is always the worst in life...

People from the lower classes were not very educated. Apparently, only kings and clerics could read. Meeh... It is a pity that nowadays this skill is not enough to become a king.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5PF73s8.gif[/img]
[h2]Let’s knock his funny hat off his head[/h2]
Culture and science in the Middle Ages were mostly subordinated to faith. At the head of the church was - and according to our catechist still stands - a powerful Vicar of God, the Pope (I wonder if his legs do not hurt from this standing). 

The priest does not part with his cane, which he constantly supports, and on his head, he wears a funny, huge hat - Barbara says that the Pope does not know fashion and has no sense of style. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/uDkQWEa.gif[/img]

All these fairy tales about princesses and knights are not so beautiful in reality. Another dangerous adventure awaits us, for which we must prepare. Remember to build durable towers, because when they are destroyed, nothing will protect us and our base! Therefore, put on your armor, grab a slingshot, and jump into practice building in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/] demo Lesson Learned.[/url]

notes.title: You too, Brutus?

This time flies so fast. This is our third lesson together. Roman Empire and Ancient Greece - today we will delve into the Iron Age! Another trip is ahead of us, so sit back and try not to fall asleep yet! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/909bc5d5f50e145c833098fef733ed6e9cb129af.png[/img]

There is a legend that the first founders of Rome were twins Romulus and Remus raised by a huge she-wolf. Personally, I don't believe in such stories, but Steven also sometimes acts like he was raised by wolves. 

In ancient Greece, they believe in many gods who take care of various areas of life. The most important is the thunderlord Zeus. Of the two evils, I would rather meet him than the ruler of the Romans, Julius Caesar...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/585a6162d200c3c9c9a22d39acd5cd452fb5abeb.png[/img]
[h2]Go back to eating grapes [/h2]

The main attraction of the Greeks are the Olympic Games. The players are very athletic and fast. We need to practice running to Gervase, our base, especially Mikey. Besides, it can help us if we need to escape!

As if that wasn't enough, the Greeks also have their warriors. Spartans are born soldiers! We need a good strategy! Maybe when we set the towers next to each other, it will be harder for them to get through?

notes.title: Land of the Pharaohs.
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

Welcome to another history lesson with Franek. Today's topic: [b]Ancient Egypt[/b]. Get out your papyrus and take notes because all the information is important! I have prepared a lot of interesting facts for you, but also tips on how to survive in this era - they will definitely be useful to you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/850b2134783b2febc79d832c256b590569e15e52.png[/img]

We call Ancient Egypt as the gift of the Nile, it is considered an extraordinary period in the history. If I had to describe this era in a few words, it would definitely be: strange buildings, gods, pharaohs and sand…a lot of sand.

The Egyptians were famous for their amazing buildings - each of you has probably seen the pyramids, even in the picture, right? They hide the tombs of great rulers and many traps. We will not build pyramids, but it would be useful to build something to defend our base - it's better that Michaś starts collecting stones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/9622e8f08f354246d95aa09818643a254e0dd2da.png[/img]
[h2]Even Sekhmet will not help you now[/h2]
Pharaoh is considered the head of Ancient Egypt. The absolute ruler, the highest of the highest, mediates between the people and the gods - almost like our Lady janitor, I would like to have such abilities too.

You must also know that the Egyptians believe in many gods, the most important of which is the sun god Re. They depict them in the form of animals or people with the head of an animal. They seem to be very scary!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8eqx9jz.gif[/img]
[h2]I have sand everywhere[/h2]
Ancient Egypt is very dangerous. When traversing the endless deserts, remember about proper hydration. I hope we will not be hit by a sandstorm or worse, THE CURSE OF TUTANKHAMON!

Amelka is not afraid at all and is very excited about our trip. She keeps saying she looks like that famous Cleopatra - I really don't understand girls.

notes.title: Stone and stick
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

Welcome to your first lesson with Franek. I promise it won't be another boring class about everything and nothing. You will gain the knowledge you need to start your adventure with me and my friends, so listen carefully! We have to start at the beginning of the timeline, so let's get to the [b]prehistory[/b]!

The era of the first people, primeval times, the beginnings of history... these are just some of the terms for the longest period of human history, since the appearance of man on Earth. 

Can you believe that people once lived in caves and grottoes, and instead of comfortable beds, they slept on the skins of hunted animals? Just thinking about it makes my back hurt and gives me shivers.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/37bf817e7e3f9ab9186132a7954b979ffa1ef05d.png[/img]

Don't let their appearance fool you. They may seem as gentle as lambs, but when you see them coming towards you with clubs and hatchets, run as fast as you can!

I think I gave you the most important information about the first era beginning our adventure and inhabitants. Traveling through forests and swamps, we can encounter many dangers. Take some provisions with you on the road and don't forget your slingshot!

May we not meet anything more dangerous than these cavemen…

notes.title: My own dreamy time machine.
notes.content:
[h1]Dear colleagues,[/h1]

All our lives we have been told that time travel does not exist...what if I told you that now it may be possible! All you have to do is close your eyes, lay down comfortably, count the sheeps in your mind and...sleep! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/38134506637f4032130fe263cb569a12afd10640.png[/img]

Today I will tell you about the adventure you will experience with me and my friends. My dreamy story is divided into stylized storyboards referring to six different historical eras. Each of them has its unique biome and levels. Doesn't sound too clear? Well, let's start from the beginning.

We begin the adventure in the time of the first humans when the most popular gadget was a stick and stone, and you could only dream about high-speed Internet - awful right? Life in [b]prehistory[/b] sucked...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/77b53d9f2281cca4da699a30d40382420e66cd91.png[/img]

The next era we will go to will be [b]antiquity.[/b] I say right away that this will not be an all-inclusive trip to Egypt. Egyptians believed in life after death, and I believe in life... after sleep, without sleep it's hard to live, isn't it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/7d02c1797f6f8d8b365196d6f66c658b5e5c509b.png[/img]

The next station is. [b]The Iron Age! [/b]Or more precisely, ancient Greece, considered the cradle of Western civilization. Mythology, art, philosophy, culture, Greek salad... Well, maybe not exactly, but you'll check it out for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/d3ff6627a7550ebdbbaee58dfae40dfaaa76e772.png[/img]

It was time for the [b]Middle Ages[/b] I don't know about you, but I have always wanted to become a knight. It is known, women love a man in armor, and Amelka looks like a princess just waiting for her prince.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/22927ecb3fe4d22f545e9ad22ef4b9102dff0b15.png[/img]

At this stage, we can safely be called explorers. Like Columbus, who discovered America. We will discover [b]modernity,[/b] which hides in its history conquests, battles, and industrialization...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/1748ac43b7117b69584f8e70c760e34cbf07a4f8.png[/img]

The last era I will introduce to you is [b]Modernity.[/b] Its beginning was quite complicated, but it is thanks to it that we now have the Internet, fast cars, and chips!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/f420bbdf20f72633e6c812bd4174c6f9d898c87a.png[/img]

You can get motion sickness from these trips... I tell you, history is not that boring at all. I encourage you to get acquainted with the first era by yourself right now by playing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/]demo Lesson Learned.[/url].

notes.title: Seeking of graphic style
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Students,[/h1]

We would like to tell you about what the process of designing our game looked like, and in particular how the creation of its visual part went. We would not like to bore you, so we will briefly tell you that [b]Lesson Learned[/b] was drawn entirely by us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/63c67fb9ec707b1203044c14882446622cdf69a9.png[/img]

It's also not like we knew from the get-go how Frank and his friends would be drawn, or what the game would ultimately look like. At the very beginning, we had the very outline of the mechanics and what our game would be about, which is our variation in the Tower Defence genre.

[b]If we managed to catch your attention, let us give you some variants, of the early concept art that was created at the very beginning during the design of the game:[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/cfd48a9ec505b87520901a281c528a805bc57a74.png[/img]

The first issue was to choose the right style and character construction. We had to consider which style would be best and allow us to cut our characters from the background. We decided on a light character outline, which highlights the character subtly and does not knock out the immersion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/78aa65915770ce68415aecfb9a7de5a459689bcd.png[/img]

Next, we could use some accessories and a more human appearance for our characters. We wanted them not to be heavily comic or exaggerated, and to resemble the students in their appearance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/8bb84790c15adca623795f588d8d885943700969.png[/img]

Like the disciples it and the South Park style we had to check it out, but in our opinion, it was too simple. In addition, it also lacked a bit of atmosphere, which we wanted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/2fe7b9d7e58de67ead677e5566349326cd7c1817.png[/img]

As fans of memes, we had to test a variant with well-known funny faces that everyone associates with. In this case, however, we didn't want to have too caricatured characters. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/68811393f1f8992861f6e5a2cb82e80770c1fce4.png[/img]

This concept relied on an outline and a strong cutaway from the background, but the characters themselves were a bit too simple. In addition, with gameplay, they may not have been fully legible to players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41350794/05dccccbda2c26ce0740effa18b41bff95ad5b2a.png[/img]

Finally, the last concept, seems to us both the clearest and the most fitting for the gameplay. In it, we were mainly inspired by the works of Tim Burton.

We got a lot of feedback from you that our game is very similar to Don't Starve. Well, you can see from this devlog that we have reworked quite a lot of different styles in order to choose just the right one for the game. Personally, we think that the game with its mechanics/visual style is quite different from this popular series. If you feel like seeing for yourself, we encourage you to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/]play our demo![/url]
